name: Develop Python web applications using Flask and Django
description: Users asked for help building, debugging, and understanding Python web applications, with a primary focus on Flask and Django frameworks. The requests covered a wide range of tasks, including implementing API endpoints, managing database models, handling file uploads, configuring security features like authentication and permissions, and troubleshooting errors in project-specific code.
